title: 第10章 好孩子摊上个渣爹！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 唐画和唐浩，今天能把他调虎离山偷钱，那以后，他们的手段是不是会更肆无忌惮？更阴险狡诈？一想到这种可能，唐逸眼眸变得前所未有的阴冷。要在这个世界活下去，他需要变得更强，更狠。他要权！他要能压制这些畜生的权！大丈夫生居天地间，岂能郁郁久居人下！……皇宫，御书房。炎文帝看着重新誊抄下来的满江红，那是越看越喜欢。大气磅礴，浩然正气，词中所表达的那种家国天下的巍峨气势，让人震撼，让人警醒。很难想象，这种霸气磅礴的诗词，会出自一个少年之手。只是想到少年那干裂粗糙的双手，显然是经历过大风大浪的人，写出这种诗词，似乎又是在情理之中。“陛下，已经查明那少年的身份了。”这时，护卫赵虎进来禀报。炎文帝猛地抬起头，道：“哦？那小家伙叫什么名字？是什么背景？”闻言，赵虎面色怪异道：“回陛下，少年名叫唐逸，那小女娃是他的妹妹唐音……他们，他们都是吏部侍郎唐敬的子女。”“嗯？”炎文帝眉头顿时皱起，有点难以置信。吏部侍郎，朝中四品，算得上权势滔天了。堂堂吏部侍郎，还养不起一对兄妹？让他们流离失所，到街头卖诗求活的地步？“赵虎，你没搞错？”炎文帝还是有点不信。“回陛下，臣没搞错。”赵虎拱手将唐敬宠妾灭妻的事说了一遍，才继续道：“所以这些年，唐逸兄妹在唐家过得很不好，堂堂唐家少爷和小姐，却过得连下人都不如。”炎文帝脸色顿时阴沉至极。经过赵虎的提醒，他自然也想到了当年唐敬的风流韵事。当年唐敬明目张胆将外室接到京都，气得柳如玉一病不起，柳家就曾上奏章弹劾过唐敬。当时他就觉得这老小子薄情寡义，极为不喜，还下旨申饬过。只是唐敬的确有点本事，上任吏部侍郎办的很多事情，都深得他心，前不久更是献计解决了朝廷官员能力不足的问题，得到嘉奖。他还当着满朝文武的面，要给他唐敬的嫡子赐婚！却没想到，老家伙的德性私下竟然烂成这样。“哼，好你个唐敬，朕真是看错你了！”“薄情寡义朕不和你计较，你竟然连自己的亲儿子和女儿，竟然都虐待成乞丐一样。”“传出去，连朕都得成为你的帮凶，成为这天下的笑话！”炎文帝双手叉腰原地转了一圈，被气到了。一个能写出满江红的少年郎，那得是多优秀的孩子？结果在你唐敬手中弃之如敝屣。怎么，你唐家有矿，人人都是大能是吧？“陛下，这……这是奴婢刚刚收到的。”这时，陈貂寺双手捧着四张银票，递到了炎文帝的面前。炎文帝愣了下，随即想到了什么，脸色顿时阴沉下来：“这是朕赐给唐逸的银票？怎么又回到你手上了？”陈貂寺吓得跪在地上，连连叩首道：“陛下，银票是云上书斋和金京楼送来的，都是皇家铺子，说是今日有人拿皇族银票买了两方砚台和一个金簪……”炎文帝眼微眯：“唐逸？”陈貂寺摇头道：“不是，是唐家主母颜霜玉……”啪！炎文帝一巴掌拍在桌上，但是都给气乐了：“呵呵，好，好得很呐，朕赏赐的银子，他们也敢抢，谁给他们的胆子！”“陛下，需要传唐侍郎入宫吗？”陈貂寺拱手问道。炎文帝大手一挥，冷喝道：“传！”陈貂寺爬起离去，没走几步又被炎文帝叫住，道：“罢了，别叫了，这点事还不值得大半夜将唐敬叫进宫……明日早朝后，朕再见他吧！”现在为了一个少年将唐敬叫进宫，还不知道外界会怎么揣测呢。到时候事情被放大，唐敬的政敌会借着唐逸攻讦唐敬。他现在还不想动唐敬，再说一个只见了一面的少年，还没有重要到让他要收拾一个朝中大臣的地步。而且唐敬是宰相的人，动了唐敬，侍郎的位置就会空出来，到时候各方人马争夺这个位置，肯定狗脑袋都得被打出来。现在北狄陈兵三十万在边境，战事一触即发，朝中安稳最重要！但是，暗中敲打敲打还是非常有必要的。否则这么好的一个苗子，就要坏在唐敬的手中了。……翌日。天刚刚蒙亮，群臣便已经云集资政殿，大朝会正式开始。炎文帝龙行虎步到龙椅坐下，等群臣行了礼，炎文帝便直接开口道：“今日早朝，不论其他，只论北狄。”“北狄三十万兵马已经陈兵边境，随时会对大炎发起战争。”“我们是打，还是不打，今日拿出个章程出来。”见到炎文帝强势果断，没有再像昨日一样和稀泥，群臣都有些懵了。咋回事？发生了什么？怎么短短一天的时间，昨日还犹豫不决的陛下，就下定决心了？顷刻间，群臣的心都提了起来。是打是和，关乎他们的利益，他们不知道皇帝到底是想打，还是想和。大殿上顿时响起了窸窣的议论声，文臣武将已经低声杠上了。炎文帝也没有催促，淡定坐在龙椅上，只是不停地抖袖子，那首《满江红》就藏在袖中，他现在很想亮出《满江红》，好好地收拾一下这群所谓的肱股之臣！连个小乞丐都知道爱国报国，不，连个不受宠的少年都知道家国天下，瞧瞧你们一群权势滔天的大臣，连个少年都不如。想到这里，炎文帝目光下意识地看向人群中的唐敬。哎，可惜了，好好的孩子，怎么就摊上这么个渣爹呢？
content_en: Tang Hua and Tang Hao were able to lure him away from the mountain and steal money today. Will their methods become more unscrupulous in the future?More sinister and cunning?When he thought of this possibility, Tang Yi's eyes became colder than ever before.To survive in this world, he needs to become stronger and more ruthless.He wants power!He must be able to suppress the power of these beasts!How can a man live in the world between heaven and earth and live in depression for a long time?...The palace, the royal study.Emperor Yanwen looked at the re-copied version of Manjianghong. The more he looked at it, the more he liked it.It is majestic and upright, and the majestic momentum of family, country and world expressed in the words is shocking and alarming.It is hard to imagine that such domineering poetry could be written by a young man.Just thinking of the young man's chapped and rough hands, he was obviously someone who had experienced strong winds and waves. It seemed reasonable to write such a poem."Your Majesty, the identity of the young man has been found out." At this time, guard Zhao Hu came in to report.Emperor Yanwen suddenly raised his head and said, "Oh? What's that little guy's name? What's his background?" Hearing this, Zhao Hu looked strange and said, "Your Majesty, the boy's name is Tang Yi, and the little girl is his sister Tang Yin... They, they are all the children of Tang Jing, the Minister of Civil Affairs." "Huh?" Emperor Yanwen suddenly frowned, a little unbelievable.The minister of the Ministry of official affairs, the fourth rank in the court, can be regarded as extremely powerful.A dignified official minister, can't afford to support a pair of brothers and sisters?Let them be displaced and sell poetry on the streets to survive?"Zhao Hu, are you right?" Emperor Yanwen still didn't believe it."Your Majesty, I am not mistaken." Zhao Hu held up his hand and told the story of Tang Jing's doting on his concubine and killing his wife, and then continued: "So these years, the Tang Yi brothers and sisters had a very bad life in the Tang family, but the young master and young lady of the Tang family were not as good as the servants." Emperor Yanwen's face suddenly became extremely gloomy.After Zhao Hu's reminder, he naturally thought of Tang Jing's romantic affair back then.At that time, Tang Jing blatantly brought the outer chamber to Kyoto, and Liu Ruyu was so angry that she couldn't afford to fall ill. The Liu family wrote a memorial to impeach Tang Jing.At that time, he felt that this old boy was unkind and unjust, and he was extremely unhappy. He even issued an order to warn him.It's just that Tang Jing does have some skills. Many of the things he did when he took up the post of Minister of Civil Affairs were very popular with him. Not long ago, he even offered suggestions to solve the problem of insufficient abilities of court officials and received a commendation.He also wanted to marry Tang Jing's legitimate son in front of the civil and military officials of the court!But he didn't expect that the old guy's moral character would be so bad in private."Humph, you Tang Jing, I really misjudged you!" "I don't care about you being unkind and unrighteous. You even tortured your own son and daughter like beggars." "If word spreads, even I will become your accomplice and become a joke in the world!" Emperor Yanwen turned around in a circle with his hands on his hips, and was angry.A young man who can write "Manjianghong", how outstanding a child must he be?As a result, it was discarded like a piece of shit in your hands, Tang Jing.Why, your Tang family has a mine, everyone is powerful, right?"Your Majesty, this...this slave just received it." At this time, Chen Diaosi held four silver notes in his hands and handed them to Emperor Yanwen.Emperor Yanwen was stunned for a moment, then thought of something, and his face suddenly darkened: "This is the silver note I gave to Tang Yi? Why did it come back to you?" Chen Diao Si was so frightened that he knelt on the ground and kowtowed repeatedly: "Your Majesty, the silver note is from Yunshang Study andThe ones sent by Jinjing Tower are all from the royal shop.They said that today someone bought two square inkstones and a gold hairpin with royal banknotes..." Emperor Yanwen narrowed his eyes and said, "Tang Yi?" Chen Diaosi shook his head and said, "No, it's Yan Shuangyu, the mother of the Tang family..." Bang!Emperor Yanwen slapped his hand on the table, but he was very happy: "Haha, good, very good, they dare to snatch the silver I rewarded, who gave them the courage!" "Your Majesty, do you need to introduce the Tang Shilang to the palace?" Chen Diaosi asked with cupped hands.Emperor Yanwen waved his hand and shouted coldly: "Pass!" Chen Diaosi got up and left, but was stopped by Emperor Yanwen after walking a few steps, saying: "Forget it, stop calling, this is not worth calling Tang Jing into the palace in the middle of the night... I will see him again after the morning court tomorrow!" Now that he called Tang Jing into the palace for a young man, I don't know what the outside world will think.When the matter becomes magnified, Tang Jing's political opponents will use Tang Yi to criticize Tang Jing.He doesn't want to touch Tang Jing yet, and besides, a young man he has only met once is not important enough for him to deal with a minister of the court.Moreover, Tang Jing is the prime minister. If Tang Jing is moved, the position of minister will be vacant. When all parties compete for this position, their heads will definitely be beaten out.Now there are 300,000 soldiers in Beidi on the border, and war is about to break out. The stability of the DPRK and China is the most important!However, it is still very necessary to beat in secret.Otherwise, such a good seedling would be ruined in Tang Jing's hands....the next day.As soon as it dawned, all the ministers had already gathered in Zizheng Hall, and the great court meeting officially began.Emperor Yanwen walked to the dragon chair and sat down. When the ministers saluted, Emperor Yanwen said directly: "Today's morning meeting, no matter what else, we will only talk about Beidi." "Beidi's 300,000 soldiers and horses have been deployed at the border, and they will launch a war against Dayan at any time." "Should we fight or not, we will come up with a charter today." Seeing that Emperor Yanwen was strong and decisive, and no longer fighting like yesterday, the officials were a little confused.What's going on?what happened?How come in just one day, His Majesty, who was still hesitant yesterday, made up his mind?In an instant, the hearts of all the ministers were raised.Whether to fight or make peace is related to their interests. They don't know whether the emperor wants to fight or make peace.There was a sudden buzz of discussion in the hall, and civil servants and generals were already talking in low voices.Emperor Yanwen did not urge him, he sat calmly on the dragon chair, and just kept shaking his sleeves. The song "Man Jiang Hong" was hidden in his sleeves. He now wanted to show "Man Jiang Hong" and take care of these so-called ministers!Even a little beggar knows how to be patriotic and serve his country. No, even an unpopular young man knows how to serve his country and his country. Look at you, a group of powerful ministers, not even as good as a young man.Thinking of this, Emperor Yanwen subconsciously looked at Tang Jing in the crowd.Hey, what a pity, how could such a good child end up with such a scumbag father?
title_en: Chapter 10 A good boy meets a scumbag father!
